SELECT sb.settle_id AS settleId, sb.round_no AS roundNo, sb.type AS type, sb.status AS status, sb.total_amount AS totalAmount, sb.planned_amount AS plannedAmount, sb.planned_tax_amount AS plannedTaxAmount, sb.planned_date AS plannedDate, sb.tax_invoice_due_date AS taxInvoiceDueDate,
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tax_invoice ti WHERE ti.settle_block_id = sb.settle_id AND ti.deleted_at IS NULL ) AS taxInvoiceLinked, sb.trader_name AS traderName, sb.bank_name AS bankName, sb.account_number AS accountNumber, sb.account_holder AS accountHolder, sb.actual_amount AS actualAmount, sb.actual_date AS actualDate, sb.created_at AS createdAt, sb.version AS version, agg.actual_amount_sum AS actualAmountSum FROM settlement_block sb JOIN block b ON b.block_id = sb.block_id JOIN step st ON st.step_id = b.step_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT st2.project_id AS project_id, sb2.type AS type, SUM(sb2.actual_amount) AS actual_amount_sum FROM settlement_block sb2 JOIN block b2 ON b2.block_id = sb2.block_id JOIN step st2 ON st2.step_id = b2.step_id WHERE sb2.deleted_at IS NULL AND st2.project_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT st3.project_id FROM settlement_block sb3 JOIN block b3 ON b3.block_id = sb3.block_id JOIN step st3 ON st3.step_id = b3.step_id WHERE sb3.settle_id IN #{id} ) GROUP BY st2.project_id, sb2.type ) agg ON agg.project_id = st.project_id AND agg.type = sb.type WHERE sb.settle_id IN #{id} AND sb.deleted_at IS NULL
